items.question: Do you travel outside Toronto?
items.answer: Yes! We regularly provide luxury photo booth rentals throughout North York, Mississauga, Scarborough, Vaughan, Etobicoke, Markham and surrounding areas for weddings, corporate events, parties and private celebrations.

items.question: What types of events do you serve?
items.answer: Weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, school dances, brand activations, galas, holiday parties, baby showers and private celebrations in Toronto and surrounding areas.

items.question: How far in advance should I book my photo booth rental?
items.answer: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially for weddings and peak event weekends. Popular dates can book several months in advance.

items.question: Can the photo booth match my event theme?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer custom overlays, premium backdrops, glam filters, neon signs, hedge walls, shimmer walls and personalized design options to match your event aesthetic and branding.

items.question: Do you set up and operate the booth during the event?
items.answer: Yes! Our team handles delivery, setup, operation and breakdown so you can enjoy a seamless, stress-free experience from start to finish.

items.question: How long does it take to set up the booth?
items.answer: Allow an hour for set up and half an hour for pack down. Set up happens before your run time starts and is included in the cost.

items.question: How many photos or prints can I have during my event?
items.answer: Unlimited prints! You also receive an online gallery with all the prints plus every single photo taken during the event.

items.question: What space do you need?
items.answer: We need at least 10 by 10 feet of space, access to a single power outlet and level ground. Please note that our backdrop stands are 8 feet tall.

items.question: Can guests instantly share their photos?
items.answer: Yes! Most of our experiences include instant text, email, AirDrop or QR code sharing so guests can post and share their photos immediately.

items.question: Do you offer custom branding for corporate events?
items.answer: Yes! We offer fully branded photo booth experiences including custom overlays, branded start screens, lead capture, logo placement and social sharing features.

items.question: Can we supply our own backdrop?
items.answer: Definitely. Choose a non reflective surface if possible. It is a good idea to brainstorm with your stylist as well.

items.answer: We need at least 10 by 10 feet of space, access to a single power outlet and level ground. Please note that our backdrop stands are 8 feet tall.

items.question: Can guests instantly share their photos?
items.answer: Yes! Most of our experiences include instant text, email, AirDrop or QR code sharing so guests can post and share their photos immediately.

items.question: Do you offer custom branding for corporate events?
items.answer: Yes! We offer fully branded photo booth experiences including custom overlays, branded start screens, lead capture, logo placement and social sharing features.

items.question: Can we supply our own backdrop?
items.answer: Definitely. Choose a non reflective surface if possible. It is a good idea to brainstorm with your stylist as well.
